controles.affirmation: Au premier semestre 2026, la societe a comptabilise 169,0 M$ d'accruals fiscaux, DONT 160,0 M$ d'obligations supplementaires liees a la Chine apres des decisions defavorables des autorites fiscales chinoises sur des positions d'exercices anterieurs. (repete a l'identique dans le bloc quantitatif sur le taux d'impot)
controles.verbatim_source: For the three and six months ended June 30, 2026, the Company recorded income tax related accruals of $39.0 and $169.0, respectively... IN ADDITION, for the six months ended June 30, 2026, the Company recorded the previously disclosed $160.0 in additional tax obligations related to China resulting from the Company's reassessment of certain tax rate assumptions applied to prior years' results NOT SUBJECT TO the tax inquiries. (10-Q T2 2026, Note 6)
controles.correction_proposee: Les 160,0 M$ s'ajoutent aux 169,0 M$, ils n'en font pas partie : total 329,0 M$. Et les 160,0 M$ ne decoulent pas des decisions defavorables elles-memes, mais d'une reevaluation par Amphenol d'hypotheses de taux appliquees a des exercices anterieurs NON couverts par les enquetes. Formulation correcte : 'la societe a comptabilise 169,0 M$ d'accruals fiscaux au premier semestre 2026, auxquels s'ajoutent 160,0 M$ d'obligations fiscales supplementaires issues d'une reevaluation de ses hypotheses de taux sur des exercices anterieurs non couverts par les enquetes chinoises'. A noter que l'ATT sous-estime par ailleurs le cout reel : Amphenol a recu des avis de paiement de 230,0 M$ (provisionnes 100,0 M$ au T4 2025 puis 130,0 M$ au T1 2026) et les a integralement payes au T2 2026.

controles.affirmation: Le 9 janvier 2026, Amphenol a boucle le rachat de l'activite connectivite et cables de CommScope pour environ 10 684,0 M$ nets de tresorerie acquise ; preuve citee : 'the Company completed three acquisitions ... including the acquisition of CommScope for approximately $10,684.0, net of cash acquired'.
controles.verbatim_source: During the first six months of 2026, the Company completed three acquisitions (collectively, the '2026 Acquisitions') for approximately $10,684.0, net of cash acquired, including the acquisition of the Connectivity and Cable Solutions business... of Vistance Networks, Inc. (10-Q T2 2026). Le 10-K FY2025 chiffre CommScope seule : 'for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $10.5 billion'.
controles.correction_proposee: Les 10 684,0 M$ correspondent aux TROIS acquisitions du semestre, pas a CommScope seule (environ 10,5 Mds $ selon le 10-K FY2025). Le verbatim cite dans la preuve a ete reordonne de facon a rattacher le montant a CommScope : il ne correspond pas au texte du filing. Ecrire : 'CommScope, la plus grosse acquisition de son histoire, pour un prix d'acquisition d'environ 10,5 Mds $ ; les trois acquisitions du semestre totalisent 10 684,0 M$ nets de tresorerie acquise'.

controles.affirmation: La Chine represente environ 16% des ventes 2025 et 37% des actifs immobilises au 31 decembre 2025, contre 29% un an plus tot, hausse liee aux investissements pour servir la demande IA.
controles.verbatim_source: During 2025, non-U.S. markets constituted approximately 65% of the Company's net sales, with China constituting approximately 16% of the Company's net sales... As of December 31, 2025, approximately 79% of the Company's long-lived assets were located outside of the United States, with approximately 37% located in China. This compares to approximately 73% and 29%, respectively, in 2024. These increases relate primarily to the significant investments the Company has made to support sales of its AI-related products.

controles.affirmation: Carnet de commandes fermes de 8,9 Mds $ fin 2025 contre 6,1 Mds $ fin 2024 ; commandes annulables avant expedition ; carnet pas forcement representatif de la demande future.
controles.verbatim_source: The Company estimates that its backlog of unfilled firm orders as of December 31, 2025 was approximately $8.9 billion compared with backlog of approximately $6.1 billion as of December 31, 2024... Unfilled orders may generally be cancelled prior to shipment of goods... Therefore, backlog may not be indicative of future demand.

controles.affirmation: IT datacom passe de 19% des ventes en 2023 a 24% en 2024 puis 36% en 2025 ; segment Communications Solutions a 62% des ventes au T2 2026 contre 42% en 2024.
controles.verbatim_source: Sales into the IT datacom market represented approximately 36% of the Company's net sales in 2025 (10-K FY2025) ; approximately 24%... in 2024 (10-K FY2024) ; approximately 19%... in 2023 (10-K FY2023) ; Net sales in the Communications Solutions segment (approximately 62% of net sales) in the second quarter of 2026 (10-Q T2 2026) ; (approximately 42% of net sales) en 2024 (10-K FY2024).

controles.affirmation: Precedent 2023 : CA en recul de 1% en dollars et 3% organiquement, tire par les declins organiques de l'IT datacom, et segment Communications Solutions en baisse de 13%.
controles.verbatim_source: Net sales were $12,554.7 for the year ended December 31, 2023... which represented a decrease of 1% in U.S. dollars and 3% organically... the decrease in net sales was driven by organic declines in the information technology and data communications ('IT datacom'), mobile networks, mobile devices, industrial and broadband communications markets ; Net sales in the Communications Solutions segment (approximately 39% of net sales) decreased 13% in U.S. dollars.

controles.affirmation: Marge operationnelle 29,5% au T2 2026 dont 80,0 M$ de recuperation de droits de douane IEEPA (environ 0,9 point) ; les acquisitions ont des charges d'exploitation superieures a la moyenne du groupe.
controles.verbatim_source: Operating income was $2,584.6, or 29.5% of net sales, for the second quarter of 2026, compared to $1,418.8, or 25.1%... due to a net benefit of $80.0 related to the recovery of International Emergency Economic Powers Act ('IEEPA') tariffs, partially offset by the effect of acquisitions, which currently have higher Operating expenses as a percentage of net sales compared to the Company average. Calcul : 80,0 / 8 758,1 = 0,91 point.

controles.affirmation: Taux d'impot effectif de 32,4% au S1 2026 contre 20,2%, et 25,3% contre 18,3% au T2 ; allegement lie aux options de 330 pb en 2026 contre 460 pb en 2025.
controles.verbatim_source: Provision for income taxes for the second quarter and first six months of 2026 was at an effective tax rate of 25.3% and 32.4%, respectively... for 2025 was at an effective tax rate of 18.3% and 20.2%... For the six months ended June 30, 2026 and 2025, stock option exercise activity had the impact of... decreasing our effective tax rate by approximately 330 basis points and 460 basis points, respectively.

controles.affirmation: CommScope a apporte 2 100,9 M$ de ventes et 190,2 M$ de resultat net du 9 janvier au 30 juin 2026, incluant 179,0 M$ d'amortissements non monetaires (137,1 apres impot) et hors charges d'interets.
controles.verbatim_source: Net sales and Net income from CommScope during this period were $2,100.9 and $190.2, respectively. Net income excludes interest expense and external transaction costs related to the acquisition and includes $179.0 ($137.1 after-tax) of non-cash amortization... Groupe six mois : 16,378.2 de ventes, 2,702.2 de resultat net. Marges recalculees : 9,05% vs 16,50% ; 15,58% en neutralisant les amortissements.

controles.verbatim_source: Net cash provided by operating activities 2,678.7 / 2,181.7 ; Capital expenditures (647.1) / (485.7) ; Net change in components of working capital (1,176.4) / (374.3) ; Net income attributable to Amphenol 2,702.2 / 1,829.1. controles.affirmation: Treize concurrents principaux nommes ; aucun client ne depasse 10% des ventes ; la societe indique ne pas toujours pouvoir repercuter la hausse des matieres premieres ; la croissance de l'IA depend de facteurs hors de son controle.
controles.verbatim_source: Primary competitors include Aptiv, Belden, Corning, Foxconn Interconnect Technology, Glenair, HUBER+SUHNER, ICT Luxshare, Jonhon, Molex, Rosenberger, Sensata, TE Connectivity and Yazaki, among others (13 noms) ; No single customer accounted for 10% or more of the Company's net sales during the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023 ; may not be able to pass along any increased raw material or component prices to its customers ; some of our customers are making significant investments in AI... The continued growth of this market will be dependent upon many factors, including our go-forward market share..., the amount and mix of capital spending by our customers, changing technology priorities and changes in government regulations and policies related to AI.
